notes: 71 unit full-body sprites double as unit-card thumbnails.
17 structure sprites double as construction and building thumbnails.
Each of the 42 age-choice research cards reuses the associated hero art; it does not need another image.
Unique image total counts each faction-specific display-name alias as its own sprite and includes resource/action/faction icons.

Nine resource and religious-stat badges are planned separately from the five world resource source sprites: Food, Timber, Precious Things, Cement, Favor, Anger, Lasciviousness, Drunkenness, and Glowing Stones.
Faction-specific visuals use stable variant key {definition_id}@{faction_id}; 60 building aliases use buildings/{id}@{faction_id}.png and two laborer aliases use units/{id}@{faction_id}.png.
Research icons are saved directly in icons/{upgrade_id}.png. Resource/devotion badges use icons/stats/{id}.png.
Runtime faction visual aliases resolve stable variant keys in the form <definition_id>@<faction_id>.
Research and definition cards use the corresponding stable IDs; the runtime icon map also accepts actions/<id>, stats/<id>, factions/<id>, and <definition_id>@<faction_id> keys.
v0.7 adds portraits for Lehi, Amulek, and Teancum plus 10 research icons. Six new age-choice icons reuse hero portraits; no extra image files are counted for those aliases.
